yt_description:
Get ready to question everything you know about sorting algorithms! 🤯 In this mind-bending episode, we dive deep into the hilariously inefficient Stooge Sort. Learn why it's called 'Stooge Sort,' how it works (or *doesn't* work efficiently), and witness its chaotic, step-by-step visualization.  Prepare for some serious algorithmic absurdity! 😂

✨ What you'll learn:
* The bizarre logic behind Stooge Sort.
* A visual walkthrough of its terrible performance.
* Why this algorithm exists (spoiler: it's a joke!).
* How *not* to sort your data! 😉
